title: India’s International Investment Position (IIP), March 2026
description: Today, the Reserve Bank released data relating to India’s International Investment Position for end-March 2026[1]. Key Features IIP during Q4:2025-26 (January-March 2026): Net claims of non-residents on India declined by US$ 52.4 billion during Q4:2025-26 to US$ 209.9 billion as at end-March 2026, driven by decline in the foreign-owned assets (US$ 40.1 billion) in India along with the rise in Indian residents’ overseas financial assets (US$ 12.3 billion) (Table 1).
